## Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

### Status
Completed

### Summary of Changes

1. **Op Types and Models ([`internal/core/ops/op.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go))**:
   - Defined `OpType` string enum with supported operations: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined `Op` struct containing `Type`, `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, `Timestamp`, `Source`, `SessionID`, and type-specific `Fields` map.
   - Defined `OpBatch` struct containing `Version` (initialized to 1), `Ops`, `CreatedAt`, and `BatchID` (ULID).
   - Added ULID helpers for batches and entry IDs: [`NewBatchID`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L52), [`NewBatchIDWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L57), [`NewEntryID`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L62), [`NewEntryIDWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L71), [`NewBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L80), and [`NewBatchWithTime`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/op.go#L94).

2. **Op File I/O ([`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/writer.go), [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/reader.go))**:
   - [`Writer.Write`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L24): Writes validated batches as indented JSON to `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`, creating monthly directory partitions with `os.MkdirAll`.
   - [`Reader.ReadBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L33): Reads and unmarshals single batch files, performing full schema validation.

3. **Op Log Iterator ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))**:
   - [`Reader.Iterate`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L68): Returns `iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]` walking month directories in lexicographical/chronological order and files within each month by ULID order.
   - [`Reader.IterateAfter`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L77): Incremental iteration filtering batches strictly after a specified `afterBatchID`.
   - [`Reader.IterateBefore`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L87): Resolves commit timestamp via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>` and filters batches strictly before the cutoff timestamp for time-cut replays.
   - Also provides pull iteration via [`Iterator.Next`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L44) / [`Iterator.Close`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L58).

4. **Validation ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/validate.go))**:
   - [`ValidateOp`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L10): Enforces required fields per op type (`add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`) supporting both Go typed structures and raw unmarshaled maps/slices.
   - [`ValidateBatch`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L170): Validates batch version, ID, non-zero timestamp, non-empty operations, and every individual op.

5. **v1 Events Migration and Deprecation ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/migrate.go), [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/events/doc.go))**:
   - Implemented [`MigrateV1Events`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/migrate.go#L13) to safely relocate `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Marked `internal/core/events` package documentation as deprecated.

6. **Unit Tests ([`internal/core/ops/ops_test.go`](file:///private/tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-dossiers-seed137/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go))**:
   - Comprehensive test suite covering validation per op type, batch validation, writer/reader round-trip, chronological iteration, incremental iteration, commit cutoff resolution, and v1 events migration.
